Technews Canva Code 2.0 is now available in the Philippines By Manila Bulletin Newsroom

With the rollout of Canva Code 2.0 in the Philippines, Canva is making AI-powered coding more accessible, allowing Filipinos to build websites with zero to minimal coding experience. A decade ago, Canva transformed design with its intuitive drag-and-drop editor, making creativity accessible to everyone. Today, Canva is doing the same for coding.
